items.zh: 新增：「检查更新」，一个入口检查 App 更新、检查资源更新、切换更新通道
items.en: New: "Check for updates" — check for app updates, check for resource updates and switch the update channel in one place

items.zh: 优化：App 更新提示改为启动器样式，可选「此版本不再提示」
items.en: Improved: the app update prompt now matches the launcher style, with "Don't remind me about this version"

items.zh: 优化：第一次更新会先申请「安装未知应用」权限，从设置回来自动继续，不再重新下载
items.en: Improved: the first in-app update asks for install permission first and continues by itself when you come back, without downloading again

items.zh: 优化：已下载好的新版本不会重复下载，点一下直接安装
items.en: Improved: a new version that is already downloaded is not downloaded again — tap once to install

items.zh: 新增：资源下载面板，显示进度、速度、剩余时间，可暂停并接着下载；可选 GitHub 在线、QQ 闪传网站或导入资源包
items.en: New: resource download panel with progress, speed and time left, pause and resume; choose GitHub online, the QQ site or import a resource pack

items.zh: 新增：国内加速线路，下载更慢时自动换线路
items.en: New: faster mirror routes, with automatic fallback to another route when a download is slow or fails

items.zh: 新增：资源更新改为可选，发现更新后看更新日志，自己决定是否更新
items.en: New: resource updates are now optional — read the changelog and decide whether to update

items.zh: 优化：更新说明按界面语言显示（中文界面看中文，其他语言看英文）
items.en: Improved: update notes follow the app language (Chinese in a Chinese UI, English otherwise)

items.zh: App 内更新使用差分包，约 2 MB，存档保留
items.en: In-app updates use a small delta package (about 2 MB), and your saves are kept
